policy: Older raster review-image batches only. Preserve all App Assets, video, model/source/export packages, original inputs, active pipeline assets and their source dependencies. Latest effective batch chosen from current workflow references; newest unreviewed batch also kept.
authorization: User confirmed retaining the latest model review-image batches and removing old batches, with App production assets preserved.
originalEvidencePolicy: Original review paths and hashes remain in manifests and append-only history. Removed images display an explicit notice; they are never replaced by newer evidence.
recovery: All removed images remain recoverable through the unchanged Git history and LFS object IDs. No remote objects or Git history have been purged.
